race.description: Taylors Hill Retirement Village F&M Mdn Plate
race.comment: Should be a good maiden but hard to go past ANGLAIS (9). Sound fourth on debut in town as a juvenile then given another break. Was off the track throughout fresh but never lay down in an eye-catching return, finishing third at Seymour. Fitter and should go close. SKYDREAM (8) was runner-up fresh then poised to strike last time but the rider lost the whip so went to the line hands and heels. Forgive that and rates highly this line-up. MY ROSALIE (7) showed ability over further last time in and presents on the back of two handy hit-outs. Looks primed to run well fresh. GALACTIC GIRL (4) has the blinkers added and should improve.
